deskSendToQrPayment: That is one part of an animated QR code. Scan the code with the camera, or paste the transaction’s whole text.

@deskSendToQrPayment.description: Error under To on desktop Send when the pasted text is one part of an animated QR Payment code (ur:epic-slate/…). Scanned by the camera, the code opens its scan; pasted, it cannot be read from one part.
